source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8.2 (PDF 222), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Creativity naye aur apne (original) andaaz mein sochne ki salahiyat hai. Is mein takhayyul (imagination) se aise ideas paida kiye jate hain jo aam se mukhtalif hon. Creativity sirf artists ya mojidon (inventors) tak mehdood nahi; yeh har shobe mein qeemti skill hai, science aur engineering se le kar karobar aur taleem tak. Bohat se Pakistani karobar customers ko apni taraf lane ke liye apni marketing mein creativity istemal karte hain.

Misal: maqami brands ne aisi pur-asar ishtihari muhimmat (advertising campaigns) banayi hain jo na sirf un ke products ki tashheer karti hain balke sunne aur dekhne walon se jazbati rishta (emotional connection) bhi banati hain.

blocks.prompt: Art (funoon) ke ilawa kisi aur shobe se creativity ki ek misal dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Maslan kisi engineer ka pani saaf karne ka sasta tareeqa dhoondna, ya kisi dukaandar ka home delivery ka naya idea.

items: Creativity: naye aur original andaaz mein sochna; har shobe mein kaam aati hai, marketing mein bhi.
